title: Honor Cargo.lock in Rust CI
why: A CI command that permits dependency re-resolution can build code different from the reviewed lockfile.
suggestion: Pass --locked or --frozen to direct Cargo build, check, test, and Clippy commands.
limitations: Only direct commands in supported checked-in CI files are inspected.
Commands hidden behind scripts, reusable workflows, aliases, or nonstandard shell wrappers are not resolved.
